checks.name: all_batch_and_tip_barrier
checks.evidence: Requires completed_all, no pending, completed count equals sealed batch count, remote main and local HEAD equal state expected_remote.

checks.name: receipt_non_circularity
checks.evidence: Receipt binds completed payload tip; closing receipt commit is deliberately verified externally.

checks.name: original_archive_unchanged
checks.evidence: Existing archive and PUBLICATION_MANIFEST are read only; seven new standalone closing files are copied with exclusive creation and SHA/size sealing.

checks.name: local_admin_backup
checks.evidence: Local ACTIVE_HANDOFF/PUBLICATION_POLICY bytes backed up in root admin before updating publication-only fields.

checks.name: goal_semantics
checks.evidence: goal_status active_unsolved, model_adopted false; only actual publication added, not model success.

checks.name: bounded_closing_push_plan
checks.evidence: Exactly seven explicit file sources, <480MiB combined; initial remote bound to completed payload tip and standard no-force verified push runner handles later commit.

nonblocking_recommendation.name: reassert_state_to_plan_binding
nonblocking_recommendation.text: The upstream push runner already binds state.plan_sha256 to actual plan bytes. Reasserting the same equality here would make the receipt helper self-contained against stale/replaced plans. Also optional direct last completed commit==tip/allremote_verified checks.

limitations: Static review only; actual remote/Git/state and file existence are not executed or inspected here. Root continues to own actual execution and remote verification.
The helper uses exclusive output creation; partial failure must be preserved and explicitly reconciled, rather than silently overwrite closing records.
